prompt: Concept art sheet for Attuned Minecraft mod Focus custom visual effects. Four square panels in one row on a dark neutral background, no text labels, no UI. Each panel shows a readable in-game particle-effect motif around an invisible player silhouette/position marker, designed to translate into vanilla Minecraft particles. Panel 1 Softstep/Umbral: smoky violet shadow footprints and low ground wisps. Panel 2 Aegis/Bastion: amber-gold hex shield ring and small protective sparks. Panel 3 Tide: cyan bubble spiral and water motes orbiting waist height. Panel 4 Ember/Cinder: orange ember arc and coal sparks snapping around a melee hit. Pixel-art inspired, Minecraft-readable at small scale, chunky high contrast, limited palette, no photorealism, no characters, no text.

implementation_targets.motif: smoky violet shadow footprints and low ground wisps
cyan bubble spiral and water motes
orange ember arc and coal sparks

review_notes: The generated sheet included visible labels even though the prompt requested none; the labels are used only in documentation/provenance, not as game assets.
The four motifs are readable enough to translate into vanilla particles without custom client assets in the first implementation slice.
Implementation should be subtle and throttled, because active Focus visuals run while a Focus is awake.
